CustomField.label: Question Text
CustomField.description: Snapshot of the related QuestionMaster__c.QuestionText__c, copied by Apex (QuestionnaireDataController.submitAnswers) when the answer is created. NOTE: this cannot be a true formula field because Salesforce formulas cannot reference a Long Text Area field (QuestionText__c is LTA) - this is a platform limitation, not a design choice. The value is fixed at submit time, which also correctly preserves the exact wording the requester answered even if the master question is edited later.
